title: Zombie
description: Three rums, lime, Donn’s Mix and falernum, flash-blended over ice.
method: Flash blended, or shaken and dumped
beforeYouStart: Have Donn’s Mix made and chilled

ingredients.note: a bitters dasher measures it easily

steps.do: Blend everything with about 1 cup of ice for about 5 seconds, just long enough to chill and froth.
steps.cue: Frothy and cold, ice still in small pieces rather than slush

steps.do: No blender? Shake everything hard in a tin with ice instead.
Dump it all into the glass, ice included. No straining.
Top up with more ice if the glass isn’t full, then add the mint sprig.

items: Jamaican aged rum: any big, funky rum with a savory edge fills the same slot.
Puerto Rican aged rum: any lighter-bodied aged rum works.
Specs vary widely, and Donn changed it himself over the years. Swap freely with what you have, as long as the tart and sour elements stay.

source.name: Jeff “Beachbum” Berry’s 1930s spec, from Strong, Sweet and Bitter: Your Guide to All Things Cocktails, Bartending and Booze from Behind the Bar by Cara Devine, p. 158
